archetypes.name: White-Blue Levelers
archetypes.plan: Build around Venerated Teacher: Spend early turns leveling efficient creatures, defend the investment, and win once their upgraded abilities come online.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Control
archetypes.plan: Build around Cadaver Imp: Trade one-for-one early, defend with high-toughness creatures, and win after card advantage exhausts the opponent.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Spawn Sacrifice
archetypes.plan: Build around Pawn of Ulamog: Create Eldrazi Spawn for mana, then sacrifice surplus tokens for removal, damage, or a large finisher.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Eldrazi Ramp
archetypes.plan: Build around Kozilek's Predator: Create Eldrazi Spawn, spend them to accelerate into huge threats, and use excess tokens to buy time.

archetypes.name: Green-White Auras
archetypes.plan: Build around Aura Gnarlid: Build one or two resilient Aura carriers, protect them from removal, and force damage through with size and evasion.
